_source_pptx: <set SLIDE_LAB_ICON_LIBRARY env var to your icon-library PPTX>
_extraction: position-based provenance only — source_x_pct/source_y_pct point to the center of the gray outline icon as seen in the source PNG. v0.1 ships icons pre-extracted; there is no live extraction step. These coordinates are kept for traceability.
_layout_notes: Each icon slide has a 6% header, then 3 rows of icon sections. Within each section, 4 icons are arranged 2x2: top-left=gray outline (this one), top-right=purple filled, bottom-left=alt-gray, bottom-right=black outline. Coordinates target the top-left gray icon.
